An interactive three-dimensional cassette machine. Audio stays on your device. Use E to open the door, Space to play or pause, S to stop, M to mute, X to disassemble. Tap arrows for previous or next; hold arrows to scan. Up and down adjust volume. Keys 1–4 focus the left, center, right, and top; Escape returns to the overview. Drag archive tapes toward the door and release to load. Click an edition on the table advertisement to change the machine; click the paper corner to pull the next sheet. Top selectors support click and drag. Click a person to greet them. Tap once, then press and hold the same object to focus. Hold Shift while dragging knobs for fine adjustment. Click the small desk calendar to toggle ambient lyrics; double-click it to focus. Press L to toggle lyrics. Double-click the stacked preference cards to save or apply a skin and equalizer group. Import a matching local LRC or enable optional online lyric lookup in settings. Manage and delete archived tapes from the magnifier search. Click the miniature online song terminal to search and play songs; only an explicitly downloaded and successfully recorded song creates an archived tape.

This machine needs WebGL 2. Please enable browser hardware acceleration and reload.
